payout_quote: Earn $500 for a limited time when you open any new Regions LifeGreen Business Checking account. 1. Open any new Regions LifeGreen Business Checking account with a Regions Visa Business Debit Card by October 2, 2026. 2. Complete at least 10 qualifying business transactions that post within 60 days of account opening. 3. Receive a $500 bonus within 60 days of completing the above requirements.
steps: Open a new Regions LifeGreen Business Checking account with a Regions Visa Business Debit Card by October 2, 2026 (appointment with a Regions Banker; branch-footprint states AL, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KY, LA, MS, MO, NC, SC, TN, TX).
Complete at least 10 qualifying business transactions that post within 60 days of account opening.
$500 bonus is deposited within 60 days of completing the requirements.
catches: Deadline: account must be opened by October 2, 2026, and 10 qualifying business transactions must post within 60 days of opening.

The page's 'View important information about this offer' disclosure carries the definitions and fine print (what counts as a qualifying business transaction) — read it before applying; it was not extractable in this verification pass.
Monthly fee on LifeGreen Business Checking is waived only with a $500 average monthly statement balance (or qualifying card/merchant activity); below that the fee erodes the bonus.
Bonus is taxable income (standard bank-bonus 1099 treatment).
Account must be a NEW Regions business checking account; existing Regions business deposit customers are ineligible.
biggest_catch: The $500 depends on completing 10 'qualifying business transactions' within 60 days of opening — the official page leaves the exact definition to its 'important information' disclosure, so confirm what counts before you count on it. Deadline to open: October 2, 2026.

timing: Open by 10/2/2026; complete 10 qualifying business transactions posting within 60 days of account opening; bonus paid within 60 days of completion.
